name: librocat
description: Persistent AI memory, shipped as an Agent Plugin. This package is the librocat MCP server: your notes and knowledge as Open Knowledge Format (OKF) Markdown files on your machine, cataloged with library and information science, retrieved by any agent. Install the whole plugin (server + Agent Skills) with `npx plugins add librocat/librocat`. Offline. Zero dependencies.
author: Laughing Hermit, Inc. <hello@librocat.dev>

scripts.build:
esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/main.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
